EVENT TITLE
Community Composting Workshop at the Garden

SHORT PUBLIC DESCRIPTION
Learn how to turn kitchen scraps and yard waste into rich, healthy soil for your garden. In this hands-on outdoor workshop at the Community Garden in Madison, we’ll cover the basics of composting, how to start and maintain a pile, and common troubleshooting tips. We’ll look at an active compost system on-site, talk about what you can and can’t compost, and share practical ideas for doing composting at home or in shared garden spaces. All experience levels are welcome.

WHEN & WHERE (for your listings)
- Date: Sunday, 14 December 2025  
- Time: 10:30 am – 12:30 pm  
- Location: Community Garden, Madison (outdoors; dress for the weather)

SUGGESTED WHAT TO BRING (optional line for the listing)
Dress for outdoor conditions and wear shoes you don’t mind getting dirty. If you’d like, bring a notebook, gloves, and any composting questions you have.

SIMPLE 2-HOUR AGENDA (10:30–12:30)
- 10:30–10:40 — Welcome & introductions  
  - Quick welcome, facilitator intro  
  - Ask participants about their composting experience and goals  

- 10:40–11:00 — Composting basics  
  - What composting is and why it matters  
  - The “ingredients”: browns vs. greens, air, and moisture  
  - Common types of compost systems (pile, bin, tumbler, community systems)  

- 11:00–11:30 — Demonstration at the compost area  
  - Tour of the garden’s compost setup  
  - What can and cannot go in the pile  
  - Layering materials and turning a pile  
  - Discuss odor, pests, and simple ways to avoid problems  

- 11:30–12:00 — Hands-on activity  
  - Participants help add materials or turn a pile (if available)  
  - Small-group observation: feel, smell, and look at finished vs. active compost  
  - Q&A during the activity  

- 12:00–12:20 — Troubleshooting & home setups  
  - How to compost in small spaces (bins, worm composting if you want to mention it)  
  - Dealing with common issues: smells, pests, slow compost  
  - How to know when compost is ready and how to use it in the garden  

- 12:20–12:30 — Wrap-up  
  - Quick recap of key points  
  - Share any local composting resources or drop-off sites  
  - Invite final questions and feedback  

If you’d like, I can also simplify or shorten this agenda further.

Next, to create a calendar event with these details, I need:
1) Your email address (as the organizer).  
2) The email addresses of any co-hosts or key attendees you want on the invite (or “none/just me” if you’ll only use it to block your own calendar).  
3) Time zone for Madison you want to use (e.g., “Central Time (US & Canada)” / America/Chicago).

5) Whether you want invites sent immediately to all attendees.

Once you provide those, I’ll create the calendar event for:
- Sunday, 14 December 2025  
- 10:30 am – 12:30 pm  
- “Community Composting Workshop at the Garden”  
with the description and agenda included.</action>
